wiki_emiss_31270.name: Homicide rate (homicides per 100,000) by federal subject, as tabulated on Wikipedia
wiki_emiss_31270.publisher: Original (as cited by Wikipedia): EMISS / fedstat.ru indicator 31270 (Unified Interdepartmental Statistical Information System, Rosstat). Taken from: Wikipedia
wiki_emiss_31270.licence: Figures: no licence stated by EMISS (not reachable to check). Wikipedia text: CC BY-SA 4.0
wiki_emiss_31270.notes: Figures taken from the English Wikipedia article 'List of federal subjects of Russia by murder rate' (revision 1225633001, 25 May 2024; wikitext saved as raw/wiki_murder_rate.wikitext). The article carries a 'More citations needed' banner. Could NOT be checked against the cited original: fedstat.ru returns HTTP 403 to the shell and WebFetch fails on it; rosstat.gov.ru and gks.ru do not connect; web.archive.org unreachable. The indicator name in EMISS was therefore not confirmed; the measure text repeats the Wikipedia table heading. Treat as secondary until checked. Only the 2006-2017 columns are cited (to EMISS 31270); the 1990, 1995, 2000 and 2005 columns have no citation and were not taken (358 values), per the rule that Wikipedia figures must carry a cited official source. 'N/A' and blank cells are not written. Rows kept as Wikipedia lists them, including former autonomous okrugs, 'Moscow Oblast within the old borders' / 'Moscow within the old borders' (values 2011-2013, including published zeros), Republic of Crimea and Sevastopol.

wiki_emiss_33559.publisher: Original (as cited by Wikipedia): EMISS / fedstat.ru indicator 33559 (Rosstat). Taken from: Wikipedia

wiki_emiss_33559.notes: Figures taken from the English Wikipedia article 'List of federal subjects of Russia by murder rate' (revision 1225633001, 25 May 2024; wikitext saved as raw/wiki_murder_rate.wikitext). The article carries a 'More citations needed' banner. Could NOT be checked against the cited original: fedstat.ru returns HTTP 403 to the shell and WebFetch fails on it; rosstat.gov.ru and gks.ru do not connect; web.archive.org unreachable. The indicator name in EMISS was therefore not confirmed; the measure text repeats the Wikipedia table heading. Treat as secondary until checked. Thousands separators removed (e.g. '28,513' -> 28513). One value kept exactly as printed and probably a typo: Urals Federal District 2014 = '1.471' (likely 1,471). Check: the federal subjects (counting Arkhangelsk and Tyumen oblasts including their autonomous okrugs, and leaving out the nested/former okrug rows and the old-borders rows) sum exactly to the Russian Federation total in every year 2006-2017. This checks the table's internal consistency only, not agreement with EMISS.

Matching notes: geoBoundaries 'Arkhangelsk Oblast' and 'Tyumen Oblast' shapes exclude their autonomous okrugs, so they are matched only to the Wikipedia rows 'Arkhangelsk Oblast (excluding Nenets AO)' and 'Tyumen Oblast (excluding Khanty-Mansiysk & Yamal-Nenets AO)'; the inclusive rows are left without shape. Crimea and Sevastopol have no shape in geoBoundaries RUS.
